name: paseo
title_zh: 项目心跳、日程、脚本一屏管完的 Paseo 操作手册
tagline_zh: 项目、工作区、脚本、Agent、日程、心跳——六样东西散在五个工具里来回切？Paseo 一个命令全收拢。
tagline_en: Projects, workspaces, scripts, agents, schedules, heartbeats—six things, five tools, one CLI. Stop tab-hopping.
desc_en: Paseo reference for managing projects, workspaces, workspace scripts, agents, schedules, and heartbeats.
why_zh: 不是教程，是官方 reference 的贴身版。把 Paseo 的实体关系（工作区挂脚本。
why_en: Not a tutorial—a re-indexed reference. Entities (workspaces→scripts, schedules→heartbeats) are reordered by how you actually.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Paseo 官方 CLI 的现有命令与参数，不含自建脚本示例、不含与外部工具（如 cron、CI）的集成写法。
limit_en: Covers only Paseo's official CLI commands & flags; no custom script examples, no cron/CI integration patterns. May lag behind new.
title_en: Paseo field guide: projects, schedules, scripts, agents
